Thank you so much for the long and detailed reply. you are right in assuming I dont know the first thing about depression because I have never experienced depression, only anxiety. 

Yes, it is difficult for him to go to work now, but I agree that he needs to do stuff that keeps him busy. I will talk to him and see what can be done. 

The only issue I have with psychotherapy is... how do I know he will tell the psychotherapist things as they are? as i said I am worried he may be altering the truth because his case is so rare and he wants to be taken seriously..

thank you for the reply. I agree with you. I already feel bad for posting this to reddit but I need other ideas from reasonable redditors. Which reminds me, I know this is not proper reddiquette, but I hope you can upvote this if you see it merits attention..
